name: Acid Resistance
description: A suit of armor or a shield with this property normally has a dull gray appearance. The armor absorbs the first 10 points of acid damage per attack that the wearer would normally take (similar to the [resist energy](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/spells/resistEnergy.htm) spell).
construction: Faint abjuration; CL 3rd; [Craft Magic Arms and Armor](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/feats.htm#craftMagicArmsAndArmor), [resist energy](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/spells/resistEnergy.htm); Price +18,000 gp.

name: Acid Resistance, Greater
description: As acid resistance, except it absorbs the first 30 points of acid damage per attack.
construction: Moderate abjuration; CL 11th; [Craft Magic Arms and Armor](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/feats.htm#craftMagicArmsAndArmor), [resist energy](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/spells/resistEnergy.htm); Price +66,000 gp.

name: Acid Resistance, Improved
description: As acid resistance, except it absorbs the first 20 points of acid damage per attack.
construction: Moderate abjuration; CL 7th; [Craft Magic Arms and Armor](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/feats.htm#craftMagicArmsAndArmor), [resist energy](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/spells/resistEnergy.htm); Price +42,000 gp.

name: Animated
description: Upon command, an animated shield floats within 2 feet of the wielder, protecting her as if she were using it herself but freeing up both her hands. Only one shield can protect a character at a time. A character with an animated shield still takes any penalties associated with shield use, such as armor check penalty, arcane spell failure chance, and nonproficiency.
construction: Strong transmutation; CL 12th; [Craft Magic Arms and Armor](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/feats.htm#craftMagicArmsAndArmor), [animate objects](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/spells/animateObjects.htm); Price +2 bonus.

name: Arrow Catching
description: A shield with this ability attracts ranged weapons to it. It has a [deflection bonus](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/theBasics.htm#deflectionBonus) of +1 against ranged weapons because [projectiles](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/equipment/weapons.htm#projectileWeapons) and [thrown weapons](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/equipment/weapons.htm#thrownWeapons) veer toward it. Additionally, any projectile or thrown weapon aimed at a target within 5 feet of the shield’s wearer diverts from its original target and targets the shield’s bearer instead. (If the wielder has [total cover](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/combat/combatModifiers.htm#totalCover) relative to the attacker, the projectile or thrown weapon is not diverted.) Additionally, those attacking the wearer with ranged weapons ignore any miss chances that would normally apply. Projectiles and thrown weapons that have an [enhancement bonus](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/theBasics.htm#enhancementBonus) higher than the shield’s base AC bonus are not diverted to the wearer (but the shield’s increased AC bonus still applies against these weapons). The wielder can activate or deactivate this ability with a [command word](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/magicItems/magicItemBasics.htm#commandWord).
construction: Moderate abjuration; CL 8th; [Craft Magic Arms and Armor](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/feats.htm#craftMagicArmsAndArmor), [entropic shield](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/spells/entropicShield.htm); Price +1 bonus.

name: Arrow Deflection
description: A shield with this ability protects the wielder from ranged attacks. Once per round when he would normally be struck by a ranged weapon, he can make a DC 20 [Reflex save](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/combat/combatStatistics.htm#reflex). If the ranged weapon has an [enhancement bonus](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/theBasics.htm#enhancementBonus), the DC increases by that amount. If he succeeds, the shield deflects the weapon. He must be aware of the attack and not [flat-footed](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/conditionSummary.htm#flatFooted). Attempting to deflect a ranged weapon doesn’t count as an action. Exceptional ranged weapons, such as boulders hurled by giants or [acid arrows](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/spells/acidArrow.htm), can’t be deflected.
construction: Faint abjuration; CL 5th; [Craft Magic Arms and Armor](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/feats.htm#craftMagicArmsAndArmor), [shield](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/spells/shield.htm); Price +2 bonus.

name: Bashing
description: A shield with this special ability is designed to perform a [shield bash](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/combat/specialAttacks.htm#shieldBashAttacks). A bashing shield deals damage as if it were a weapon of two size categories larger (a Medium light shield thus deals 1d6 points of damage and a Medium heavy shield deals 1d8 points of damage). The shield acts as a +1 weapon when used to bash. (Only light and heavy shields can have this ability.)
construction: Moderate transmutation; CL 8th; [Craft Magic Arms and Armor](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/feats.htm#craftMagicArmsAndArmor), [bull’s strength](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/spells/bullsStrength.htm); Price +1 bonus.

name: Blinding
description: A shield with this ability flashes with a brilliant light up to twice per day upon command of the wielder. Anyone within 20 feet except the wielder must make a DC 14 [Reflex save](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/combat/combatStatistics.htm#reflex) or be [blinded](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/conditionSummary.htm#blinded) for 1d4 rounds.
construction: Moderate evocation; CL 7th; [Craft Magic Arms and Armor](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/feats.htm#craftMagicArmsAndArmor), [searing light](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/spells/searingLight.htm); Price +1 bonus.

name: Cold Resistance
description: A suit of armor or a shield with this property normally has a bluish, icy hue or is adorned with furs and shaggy pelts. The armor absorbs the first 10 points of cold damage per attack that the wearer would normally take (similar to the [resist energy](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/spells/resistEnergy.htm) spell).
construction: Faint abjuration; CL 3rd; [Craft Magic Arms and Armor](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/feats.htm#craftMagicArmsAndArmor), [resist energy](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/spells/resistEnergy.htm); Price +18,000 gp.

name: Electricity Resistance
description: A suit of armor or a shield with this property normally has a bluish hue and often bears a storm or lightning motif. The armor absorbs the first 10 points of electricity damage per attack that the wearer would normally take (similar to the [resist energy](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/spells/resistEnergy.htm) spell).
construction: Faint abjuration; CL 3rd; [Craft Magic Arms and Armor](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/feats.htm#craftMagicArmsAndArmor), [resist energy](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/spells/resistEnergy.htm); Price +18,000 gp.

name: Electricity Resistance, Greater
description: As electricity resistance, except it absorbs the first 30 points of electricity damage per attack.
construction: Moderate abjuration; CL 11th; [Craft Magic Arms and Armor](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/feats.htm#craftMagicArmsAndArmor), [resist energy](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/spells/resistEnergy.htm); Price +66,000 gp.

name: Electricity Resistance, Improved
description: As electricity resistance, except it absorbs the first 20 points of electricity damage per attack.
construction: Moderate abjuration; CL 7th; [Craft Magic Arms and Armor](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/feats.htm#craftMagicArmsAndArmor), [resist energy](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/spells/resistEnergy.htm); Price +42,000 gp.

name: Etherealness
description: On command, this ability allows the wearer of the armor to become [ethereal](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/specialAbilities.htm#etherealness) (as the [ethereal jaunt](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/spells/etherealJaunt.htm) spell) once per day. The character can remain ethereal for as long as desired, but once he returns to normal, he cannot become ethereal again that day.
construction: Strong transmutation; CL 13th; [Craft Magic Arms and Armor](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/feats.htm#craftMagicArmsAndArmor), [ethereal jaunt](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/spells/etherealJaunt.htm); Price +49,000 gp.

name: Fire Resistance
description: A suit of armor with this ability normally has a reddish hue and often is decorated with a draconic motif. The armor absorbs the first 10 points of fire damage per attack that the wearer would normally take (similar to the [resist energy](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/spells/resistEnergy.htm) spell).
construction: Faint abjuration; CL 3rd; [Craft Magic Arms and Armor](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/feats.htm#craftMagicArmsAndArmor), [resist energy](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/spells/resistEnergy.htm); Price +18,000 gp.

name: Fire Resistance, Greater
description: As fire resistance, except it absorbs the first 30 points of fire damage per attack.
construction: Moderate abjuration; CL 11th; [Craft Magic Arms and Armor](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/feats.htm#craftMagicArmsAndArmor), [resist energy](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/spells/resistEnergy.htm); Price +66,000 gp.

name: Fire Resistance, Improved
description: As fire resistance, except it absorbs the first 20 points of fire damage per attack.
construction: Moderate abjuration; CL 7th; [Craft Magic Arms and Armor](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/feats.htm#craftMagicArmsAndArmor), [resist energy](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/spells/resistEnergy.htm); Price +42,000 gp.

name: Fortification
description: This suit of armor or shield produces a magical force that protects vital areas of the wearer more effectively. When a [critical hit](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/combat/actionsInCombat.htm#criticalHits) or sneak attack is scored on the wearer, there is a chance that the critical hit or sneak attack is negated and damage is instead rolled normally.
construction: Strong abjuration; CL 13th; [Craft Magic Arms and Armor](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/feats.htm#craftMagicArmsAndArmor), [limited wish](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/spells/limitedWish.htm) or [miracle](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/spells/miracle.htm); Price varies (see above).

name: Ghost Touch
description: This armor or shield seems almost translucent. Both its [enhancement bonus](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/theBasics.htm#enhancementBonus) and its [armor bonus](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/theBasics.htm#armorBonus) count against the attacks of [incorporeal creatures](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/typesSubtypes.htm#incorporealSubtype). It can be picked up, moved, and worn by incorporeal creatures at any time. Incorporeal creatures gain the armor or shield’s enhancement bonus against both corporeal and [incorporeal](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/specialAbilities.htm#incorporeality) attacks, and they can still pass freely through solid objects.
construction: Strong transmutation; CL 15th; [Craft Magic Arms and Armor](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/feats.htm#craftMagicArmsAndArmor), [etherealness](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/spells/etherealness.htm); Price +3 bonus.

name: Glamered
description: A suit of armor with this ability appears normal. Upon command, the armor changes shape and form to assume the appearance of a normal set of clothing. The armor retains all its properties (including weight) when glamered. Only a [true seeing](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/spells/trueSeeing.htm) spell or similar magic reveals the true nature of the armor when disguised.
construction: Moderate illusion; CL 10th; [Craft Magic Arms and Armor](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/feats.htm#craftMagicArmsAndArmor), [disguise self](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/spells/disguiseSelf.htm); Price +2,700 gp.

name: Invulnerability
description: This suit of armor grants the wearer [damage reduction](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/specialAbilities.htm#damageReduction) of 5/magic.
construction: Strong abjuration and perhaps evocation (if [miracle](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/spells/miracle.htm) is used); CL 18th; [Craft Magic Arms and Armor](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/feats.htm#craftMagicArmsAndArmor), [stoneskin](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/spells/stoneskin.htm), [wish](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/spells/wish.htm) or [miracle](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/spells/miracle.htm); Price +3 bonus.

name: Reflecting
description: This shield seems like a mirror. Its surface is completely reflective. Once per day, it can be called on to reflect a spell back at its caster exactly like the [spell turning](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/spells/spellTurning.htm) spell.
construction: Strong abjuration; CL 14th; [Craft Magic Arms and Armor](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/feats.htm#craftMagicArmsAndArmor), [spell turning](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/spells/spellTurning.htm); Price +5 bonus.

name: Shadow
description: This armor is jet black and blurs the wearer whenever she tries to hide, granting a +5 [competence bonus](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/theBasics.htm#competenceModifier) on [Hide](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/skills/hide.htm) checks. (The armor’s armor check penalty still applies normally.)
construction: Faint illusion; CL 5th; [Craft Magic Arms and Armor](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/feats.htm#craftMagicArmsAndArmor), [invisibility](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/spells/invisibility.htm); Price +3,750 gp.

name: Shadow, Greater
description: As shadow, except it grants a +15 [competence bonus](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/theBasics.htm#competenceModifier) on [Hide](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/skills/hide.htm) checks.
construction: Moderate illusion; CL 15th; [Craft Magic Arms and Armor](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/feats.htm#craftMagicArmsAndArmor), [invisibility](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/spells/invisibility.htm); Price +33,750 gp.

name: Shadow, Improved
description: As shadow, except it grants a +10 [competence bonus](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/theBasics.htm#competenceModifier) on [Hide](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/skills/hide.htm) checks.
construction: Moderate illusion; CL 10th; [Craft Magic Arms and Armor](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/feats.htm#craftMagicArmsAndArmor), [invisibility](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/spells/invisibility.htm); Price +15,000 gp.

name: Silent Moves
description: This armor is well oiled and magically constructed so that it not only makes little sound, but it dampens sound around it. It provides a +5 [competence bonus](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/theBasics.htm#competenceModifier) on its wearer’s [Move Silently](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/skills/moveSilently.htm) checks. (The armor’s armor check penalty still applies normally.)
construction: Faint illusion; CL 5th; [Craft Magic Arms and Armor](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/feats.htm#craftMagicArmsAndArmor), [silence](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/spells/silence.htm); Price +3,750 gp.

name: Silent Moves, Greater
description: As silent moves, except it grants a +15 [competence bonus](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/theBasics.htm#competenceModifier) on [Move Silently](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/skills/moveSilently.htm) checks.
construction: Moderate illusion; CL 15th; [Craft Magic Arms and Armor](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/feats.htm#craftMagicArmsAndArmor), [silence](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/spells/silence.htm); Price +33,750 gp.

name: Silent Moves, Improved
description: As silent moves, except it grants a +10 [competence bonus](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/theBasics.htm#competenceModifier) on [Move Silently](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/skills/moveSilently.htm) checks.
construction: Moderate illusion; CL 10th; [Craft Magic Arms and Armor](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/feats.htm#craftMagicArmsAndArmor), [silence](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/spells/silence.htm); Price +15,000 gp.

name: Slick
description: Slick armor seems coated at all times with a slightly greasy oil. It provides a +5 [competence bonus](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/theBasics.htm#competenceModifier) on its wearer’s [Escape Artist](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/skills/escapeArtist.htm) checks. (The armor’s armor check penalty still applies normally.)
construction: Faint conjuration; CL 4th; [Craft Magic Arms and Armor](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/feats.htm#craftMagicArmsAndArmor), [grease](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/spells/grease.htm); Price +3,750 gp.

name: Slick, Greater
description: As slick, except it grants a +15 [competence bonus](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/theBasics.htm#competenceModifier) on [Escape Artist](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/skills/escapeArtist.htm) checks.
construction: Moderate conjuration; CL 15th; [Craft Magic Arms and Armor](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/feats.htm#craftMagicArmsAndArmor), [grease](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/spells/grease.htm); Price +33,750 gp.

name: Slick, Improved
description: As slick, except it grants a +10 [competence bonus](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/theBasics.htm#competenceModifier) on [Escape Artist](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/skills/escapeArtist.htm) checks.
construction: Moderate conjuration; CL 10th; [Craft Magic Arms and Armor](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/feats.htm#craftMagicArmsAndArmor), [grease](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/spells/grease.htm); Price +15,000 gp.

name: Sonic Resistance
description: A suit of armor or a shield with this property normally has a glistening appearance. The armor absorbs the first 10 points of [sonic](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/specialAbilities.htm#sonicAttacks) damage per attack that the wearer would normally take (similar to the [resist energy](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/spells/resistEnergy.htm) spell).
construction: Faint abjuration; CL 3rd; [Craft Magic Arms and Armor](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/feats.htm#craftMagicArmsAndArmor), [resist energy](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/spells/resistEnergy.htm); Price +18,000 gp.

name: Sonic Resistance, Greater
description: As sonic resistance, except it absorbs the first 30 points of [sonic](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/specialAbilities.htm#sonicAttacks) damage per attack.
construction: Moderate abjuration; CL 11th; [Craft Magic Arms and Armor](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/feats.htm#craftMagicArmsAndArmor), [resist energy](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/spells/resistEnergy.htm); Price +66,000 gp.

name: Sonic Resistance, Improved
description: As sonic resistance, except it absorbs the first 20 points of [sonic](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/specialAbilities.htm#sonicAttacks) damage per attack.
construction: Moderate abjuration; CL 7th; [Craft Magic Arms and Armor](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/feats.htm#craftMagicArmsAndArmor), [resist energy](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/spells/resistEnergy.htm); Price +42,000 gp.

name: Spell Resistance
description: This property grants the armor’s wearer [spell resistance](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/specialAbilities.htm#spellResistance) while the armor is worn. The spell resistance can be 13, 15, 17, or 19, depending on the armor.
construction: Strong abjuration; CL 15th; [Craft Magic Arms and Armor](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/feats.htm#craftMagicArmsAndArmor), [spell resistance](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/spells/spellResistance.htm); Price +2 bonus (SR 13), +3 bonus (SR 15), +4 bonus (SR 17), or +5 bonus (SR 19).

name: Undead Controlling
description: The wearer of a suit of armor or a shield with this property may control up to 26 HD of undead per day, as the [control undead](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/spells/controlUndead.htm) spell. At dawn each day, the wearer loses control of any undead still under his sway. Armor or a shield with this ability appears to be made of bone; this feature is entirely decorative and has no other effect on the armor.
construction: Strong necromancy; CL 13th; [Craft Magic Arms and Armor](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/feats.htm#craftMagicArmsAndArmor), [control undead](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/spells/controlUndead.htm); Price +49,000 gp.

name: Wild
description: The wearer of a suit of armor or a shield with this ability preserves his [armor bonus](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/theBasics.htm#armorBonus) (and any [enhancement bonus](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/theBasics.htm#enhancementBonus)) while in a wild shape. Armor and shields with this ability usually appear to be made covered in leaf patterns. While the wearer is in a wild shape, the armor cannot be seen.
construction: Moderate transmutation; CL 9th; [Craft Magic Arms and Armor](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/feats.htm#craftMagicArmsAndArmor), [baleful polymorph](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/spells/balefulPolymorph.htm); Price +3 bonus.
